name: Fiji Goshawk
rangeDescription: Fiji
description: A small goshawk with pale grayish-blue wings and head and a peachy reddish collar, chest, and belly. Note the piercing orange eye and orange legs.

name: Eastern Kingbird
rangeDescription: Eastern north america; winters mainly western amazon basin
description: Fairly large flycatcher, dark gray above and clean white below with blacker head. Look for white tail tip.

name: Layard's Parakeet
rangeDescription: Sri lanka
description: Bright green, long-tailed parrot, with a gray hood and conspicuous black throat. The beak is red-orange in males, but all dark in duller females.

name: Green Figbird
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (rote, semau, and timor)
description: Male figbird is a distinctive oriole with a moss-green body and a black head with bright red facial skin. Female is brown, with a heavily streaked lighter underside and dull blue-gray or pinkish facial skin.

name: Bornean Spiderhunter
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern, central, and eastern borneo
description: Medium-sized spiderhunter with an olive back and streaked gray underparts. Inhabits lowland and submontane forests and forest edges, where it feeds primarily on nectar in the understory; favors blossoms of banana and ginger.

name: Meyer's Goshawk
rangeDescription: Moluccas to new guinea, new britain (southeastern bismarck archipelago), and solomon islands
description: A rare, powerful raptor of hill and montane forest edge and clearings. Black upperparts and white underparts with fine black barring on the flanks.

name: Belted Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Central and eastern canada to northern south america including trinidad and tobago and west indies
description: Stocky and large-headed with a shaggy crest. Bill is long, straight, thick, and pointed.

name: Olive-headed Weaver
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern tanzania, zambia, malawi, and mozambique
description: A localized woodland weaver that has a dusky-olive head and upperparts, and golden-yellow underparts. Brighter male has a golden-yellow crown and more extensive rusty breast patch.

name: Yellow-eyed Penguin
rangeDescription: Auckland, stewart, campbell, and south islands (new zealand)
description: A tall, stocky penguin endemic to New Zealand. Note the conspicuous soft, yellow uncrested band that stretches across the back of the head to circle each distinctly yellow eye.

name: Cryptic Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Submontane forest of mindanao (southern philippines)
description: A small bird of foothill and low-elevation montane forest on Mindanao. Dark brown above with a rufous tail, a white belly, a pale gray chest, and a buffy face and throat.

name: Pringle's Puffback
rangeDescription: Ethiopia and somalia to kenya and northeastern tanzania
description: A small bushshrike in which males and females are strikingly different. Males are black and gray on the upperparts, whitish below.

name: Santo Thicketbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of espiritu santo (vanuatu)
description: A relatively thick-bodied, long-tailed warbler, prone to creeping like a mouse low in vegetation. Dark brown above.

name: Nazca Booby
rangeDescription: Breeds galapagos and islands off western mexico
description: Large seabird, very similar to Masked Booby. Long and pointy on all ends: wings, tail, and bill.

name: Stripe-cheeked Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands and foothills on both slopes of panama
description: This scarce small woodpecker is golden-olive above and barred below. The male has a red crown, a red mustache stripe, and a yellow stripe below the eye.

name: Indian Peafowl
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of eastern pakistan, india, and sri lanka
description: An unmistakable, large ground bird. The unmistakable iridescent blue male spreads out its ornamental upper tail feathers when courting females.

name: Short-bearded Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (mount wilhelmina in snow mountains)
description: A long, slender honeyeater of subalpine forest and shrubland in western New Guinea. All sooty gray-black plumage with a long tail and a fairly long, curved bill, 2 white tufts emanating from the base of the bill, and a yellow-orange wattle at the back of the eye.

name: Gould's Frogmouth
rangeDescription: Peninsular thailand to malay peninsula, sumatra, borneo, and adjacent islands
description: Cryptic, seldom-seen nightbird of lowland and foothill forests. Unlike other small frogmouths, sexes are alike.

name: Jouanin's Petrel
rangeDescription: Northwestern indian ocean and southern arabian sea; breeding grounds unknown
description: An all-dark, pigeon-sized petrel. Very bulky, with broad wings and a heavy, dark bill.

name: Timor Oriole
rangeDescription: Rote, timor, and semau (eastern lesser sundas)
description: Male is a distinctive oriole with a green head, dark mask, and orange-red bill. Duller female is brown above and paler below, with a dark mask and black bill.

name: White-tailed Jay
rangeDescription: Arid southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru (south to la libertad)
description: One of the most striking and recognizable birds of the dry “Tumbesian Region” that encompasses parts of western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. No other bird in range has a similar blue, white, and black pattern.
